# HumanMetrix

> HumanMetrix is an enterprise-grade AI assessment platform for recruitment and career development. It objectively measures behavioural skills and AI literacy so organisations can identify the right candidates for AI-driven roles — quickly, fairly and at scale. Operated by PT Human Metrix Assessments. Canonical site: https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk

## About

HumanMetrix provides four core assessment types: FIT (behavioural competency), AI Readiness (how effectively a person works with AI tools), Prompt Architecture, and the Algorithmic Integrity Quotient (AIQ). Scoring uses a fixed golden-set benchmark for reproducibility, with regionally localised content and Purchasing Power Parity pricing. The platform serves recruitment agencies, in-house talent teams, enterprise partners, and individuals certifying their AI literacy.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/): Platform overview and primary entry point.
- [Assessments](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/assessments): The FIT, AI Readiness, Prompt Architecture and AIQ assessments and what each measures.
- [Pricing](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/pricing): Transparent pricing for individuals and enterprise partners, with multi-currency and PPP support.
- [Ecosystem Index](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/ecosystem-index): AI-powered team capability diagnostic — mission analysis, team FIT aggregation and gap analysis.
- [Cohort Benchmarking](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/cohort-benchmarking): Compare groups of candidates against each other and against role requirements.

## Credibility and trust

- [Methodology](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/methodology): The psychometric scoring, situational judgement design, golden-set benchmark and role-customisation approach behind the assessments.
- [Enterprise](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/enterprise): Flat-rate enterprise subscriptions and infrastructure for high-volume hiring.
- [Partnerships](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/partnerships): White-label and channel partnership options for recruitment and HR-tech businesses.
- [Trust Center](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/security): Security, data handling and infrastructure overview.

## For developers

- [Developer Integration Guide](https://www.humanmetrix.co.uk/developers): Embed assessments via the JavaScript widget, SDK, REST API and webhooks, including ATS and HR-tech integration.
